div.div:
Legend
verified link (ATT&CK, KEV, NVD, CTID)
LLM-inferred link: separate type, never in verified queries (D12)
key UNIQUE: uniqueness constraint, backed by an index
RANGE INDEX: range index for filtering and sorting
(n): live node count measured 2026-10-15
blue ATT&CK orange KEV / NVD grey import metadata

box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Constraints, indexes and rules
• Uniqueness on stix_id and attack_id for :Group, :Campaign, :Software, :Technique, :Tactic, :Mitigation. :Software covers :Malware and :Tool; :Technique covers :SubTechnique (D1, D3, D5).
• Uniqueness on :CVE(cve_id), :CWE(cwe_id), :Product(product_key), :Vendor(vendor_key), :ImportMeta(source).
• Range index on :CVE(cvss_score) (D8).
• Neo4j Community: no property-existence constraints, so import scripts validate required properties.
• Revoked / deprecated ATT&CK objects are not loaded; stale CTID ids are remapped via revoked-by (D2).
• Group ↔ CVE is only ever a shared-technique path, never a direct link (D12).
